final: WITH line_counts AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS s FROM line_counts), ratio_rows AS (SELECT lc.color, lc.cnt, 1.0 * lc.cnt / t.s AS ratio FROM line_counts lc CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.s IS NOT NULL), avg_row AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM ratio_rows), kept AS (SELECT rr.cnt, rr.ratio FROM ratio_rows rr CROSS JOIN avg_row av WHERE av.a IS NOT NULL AND rr.cnt > av.a) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(cnt - (SELECT a FROM avg_row)) AS avg_excess FROM kept
